Description: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Changelog: Fixed the Characters database keeping an old house after it was lost or sold. Both the private house and the FC house now clear once the game reports no house, either on the regular background update every 2 minutes or right away when pressing the Test button. Right after login the saved house is still kept, since housing data may not have loaded yet.
